**Aturan (pre-specified):**

1. Untuk tiap provinsi dan tiap bulan, jalankan LISA (Queen+bridge v2,
   variabel `treatment_started_per_100k_population`, `alpha = 0.05`,
   FDR Benjamini-Hochberg dihitung **per bulan** lintas 38 provinsi --
   konsisten dengan cara S2-DAM-02 mengoreksi multiple testing untuk satu
   cross-section).
2. Satu provinsi-bulan dianggap **signifikan** kalau `p_fdr < 0.05` --
   BUKAN p mentah, supaya konsisten dengan standar yang sudah dipakai
   S2-DAM-02.
3. Hitung `n_HH` = jumlah bulan (dari 24) provinsi itu signifikan **dan**
   High-High; `n_LL` = jumlah bulan signifikan **dan** Low-Low.
4. Klasifikasi akhir per provinsi (5 kategori, saling eksklusif):

   | Kategori | Syarat |
   |---|---|
   | **Persistent Hotspot** | `n_HH >= 12` (signifikan HH di >=50% dari 24 bulan) |
   | **Persistent Coldspot** | `n_LL >= 12` |
   | **Sporadic Hotspot** | `0 < n_HH < 12` dan `n_LL == 0` |
   | **Sporadic Coldspot** | `0 < n_LL < 12` dan `n_HH == 0` |
   | **Mixed/Unstable** | `n_HH > 0` **dan** `n_LL > 0` (pernah HH, pernah LL -- klasifikasi tidak stabil) |
   | **Not significant** | `n_HH == 0` dan `n_LL == 0` (tidak pernah signifikan HH/LL di bulan manapun) |

   Ambang 12/24 (50%) dipilih karena merupakan titik tengah yang paling
   netral (tidak condong ke syarat longgar atau ketat) -- bukan dipilih
   setelah melihat distribusi hasil.

# 4. Root repository dan path

```{r paths}
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd(), max_up = 6) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  for (i in 0:max_up) {
    candidate <- file.path(current, "data", "processed")
    if (dir.exists(candidate)) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop(
    "Root repository TB-INSIGHT tidak ditemukan. Pastikan Rmd dijalankan dari dalam repository.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

ROOT <- find_repo_root()

PANEL <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed", "analysis_panel_province_month_2024_2025.csv")
BOUNDARY <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed", "province_boundaries_38.geojson")
PRIMARY_EDGES_V2 <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed", "spatial_weights_v2_queen_bridge.csv")
CURATED <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "processed")

check_file <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(
      "File tidak ditemukan: ", path,
      " -- jalankan dulu S2-DAM-01 supaya file ini dibuat.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

check_file(PANEL)
check_file(BOUNDARY)
check_file(PRIMARY_EDGES_V2)

cat("Repository root:", ROOT, "\n")
```

# 5. Parameter reproducibility


```{r parameters}
SEED <- 20260902
N_PERMUTATIONS <- 999
ALPHA <- 0.05
PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS <- 12  # dari 24 bulan (50%) -- lihat bagian 2

SEED; N_PERMUTATIONS; ALPHA; PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS
```

# 6. Load boundary, weights primer, dan panel

```{r load-data}
boundary_sf <- st_read(BOUNDARY, quiet = TRUE)
province_order <- boundary_sf$province

primary_edges_v2 <- read_csv(PRIMARY_EDGES_V2, show_col_types = FALSE)

build_primary_nb <- function(province_order, edges) {
  neighbors <- setNames(vector("list", length(province_order)), province_order)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges))) {
    a <- edges$province_a[i]; b <- edges$province_b[i]
    if (is.na(a) || is.na(b)) next
    neighbors[[a]] <- unique(c(neighbors[[a]], b))
    neighbors[[b]] <- unique(c(neighbors[[b]], a))
  }
  nb <- structure(
    lapply(neighbors, function(x) if (length(x) == 0) integer(0) else match(x, province_order)),
    class = "nb", region.id = province_order, call = match.call()
  )
  attr(nb, "sym") <- TRUE
  nb
}

nb_primary <- build_primary_nb(province_order, primary_edges_v2)
w_primary <- nb2listw(nb_primary, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

n_island_primary <- sum(card(nb_primary) == 0)
n_components_primary <- n.comp.nb(nb_primary)$nc
cat("Provinsi tanpa tetangga (primer):", n_island_primary, "\n")
cat("Connected components (primer):", n_components_primary, "\n")

panel <- read_csv(
  PANEL,
  col_types = cols(province_code = col_character())
)

periods <- sort(unique(panel$period))
cat("Jumlah bulan:", length(periods), "\n")
```

# 7. Fungsi LISA satu bulan 

Kolom p-value dipilih eksplisit (bukan tebakan), `iseed` dipakai untuk
reproducibility permutasi -- identik dengan pendekatan S2-DAM-02.

```{r lisa-function}
run_lisa_month <- function(y, listw, province_order, seed, permutations, alpha) {

  set.seed(seed)

  lisa_raw <- localmoran_perm(
    y, listw,
    nsim = permutations,
    iseed = seed,
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )
  lisa_df <- as.data.frame(lisa_raw)

  P_COL_PRIORITY <- c("Pr(folded) Sim", "Pr(z != E(Ii)) Sim")
  p_col_name <- P_COL_PRIORITY[P_COL_PRIORITY %in% colnames(lisa_df)][1]

  if (is.na(p_col_name)) {
    stop(
      "Tidak ada kolom p-value permutasi yang dikenali. Kolom tersedia:\n",
      paste(colnames(lisa_df), collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  p_sim <- lisa_df[[p_col_name]]
  p_fdr <- p.adjust(p_sim, method = "fdr")

  y_z <- as.numeric(scale(y))
  y_lag_z <- as.numeric(scale(lag.listw(listw, y, zero.policy = TRUE)))

  quadrant <- character(length(y))
  quadrant[y_z >= 0 & y_lag_z >= 0] <- "High-High"
  quadrant[y_z < 0  & y_lag_z < 0]  <- "Low-Low"
  quadrant[y_z < 0  & y_lag_z >= 0] <- "Low-High"
  quadrant[y_z >= 0 & y_lag_z < 0]  <- "High-Low"

  label_fdr <- ifelse(p_fdr < alpha, quadrant, "Insignificant")

  tibble(
    province = province_order,
    p_sim = p_sim,
    p_fdr = p_fdr,
    quadrant = quadrant,
    label_fdr = label_fdr
  )
}
```

# 8. Menjalankan LISA untuk 24 bulan

```{r run-monthly-lisa}
monthly_lisa <- lapply(periods, function(p) {
  y_month <- panel |>
    filter(period == p) |>
    arrange(match(province, province_order)) |>
    pull(treatment_started_per_100k_population)

  result <- run_lisa_month(
    y = y_month,
    listw = w_primary,
    province_order = province_order,
    seed = SEED,
    permutations = N_PERMUTATIONS,
    alpha = ALPHA
  )
  result$period <- p
  result
}) |> bind_rows()

cat("Total baris (38 provinsi x 24 bulan):", nrow(monthly_lisa), "\n")

knitr::kable(head(monthly_lisa, 10), digits = 4, caption = "Contoh hasil LISA bulanan")
```

# 9. Menerapkan definisi persistence (bagian 2) ke hasil

```{r persistence-classification}
persistence <- monthly_lisa |>
  group_by(province) |>
  summarise(
    n_HH = sum(label_fdr == "High-High"),
    n_LL = sum(label_fdr == "Low-Low"),
    n_HL = sum(label_fdr == "High-Low"),
    n_LH = sum(label_fdr == "Low-High"),
    n_significant_months = sum(label_fdr != "Insignificant"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    persistence_category = case_when(
      n_HH >= PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS ~ "Persistent Hotspot",
      n_LL >= PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS ~ "Persistent Coldspot",
      n_HH > 0 & n_LL > 0                  ~ "Mixed/Unstable",
      n_HH > 0                             ~ "Sporadic Hotspot",
      n_LL > 0                             ~ "Sporadic Coldspot",
      TRUE                                 ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) |>
  right_join(tibble(province = province_order), by = "province") |>
  arrange(match(province, province_order))

# Pastikan semua kategori punya level eksplisit walau tidak ada anggotanya --
# supaya legend peta tetap menampilkan semua kategori (AC: jangan sembunyikan).
PERSISTENCE_LEVELS <- c(
  "Persistent Hotspot", "Persistent Coldspot",
  "Sporadic Hotspot", "Sporadic Coldspot",
  "Mixed/Unstable", "Not significant"
)
persistence$persistence_category <- factor(persistence$persistence_category, levels = PERSISTENCE_LEVELS)

knitr::kable(
  persistence |> count(persistence_category, .drop = FALSE),
  caption = "Jumlah provinsi per kategori persistence (semua kategori ditampilkan, termasuk yang 0)"
)

# --- Diagnostik: pastikan hasil "semua abu-abu" (kalau terjadi) itu genuine,
# bukan bug join/logic. Kalau baris NA muncul di sini, ada province name
# yang tidak match -- itu baru bug. Kalau NA = 0 dan "Not significant"
# tinggi, itu temuan asli (konsisten dengan S2-DAM-02: 0 signifikan FDR
# bahkan di cross-section rata-rata 24 bulan yang paling kuat dayanya).
cat("--- Diagnostik ---\n")
cat("Distribusi kategori (useNA, harus 0 NA):\n")
print(table(persistence$persistence_category, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nTotal provinsi-bulan signifikan FDR di seluruh 912 baris:", sum(monthly_lisa$label_fdr != "Insignificant"), "\n")
cat("Provinsi yang PERNAH signifikan FDR minimal 1 bulan (n_HH>0 atau n_LL>0):", sum(persistence$n_HH > 0 | persistence$n_LL > 0), "/", nrow(persistence), "\n")

knitr::kable(persistence, caption = "Klasifikasi persistence per provinsi (38 baris, tidak ada yang disembunyikan)")
```

## 9a. Versi eksploratif -- persistence berbasis p mentah (tanpa FDR)

Kalau peta FDR di bagian 10 didominasi abu-abu ("Not significant"), itu
bukan berarti tidak ada pola sama sekali untuk dieksplorasi, cuma
berarti tidak ada yang **cukup kuat secara statistik ketat** untuk lolos
koreksi 38 uji simultan per bulan. Sebagai pembanding eksploratif (BUKAN
pengganti hasil FDR di atas), versi yang sama dihitung ulang memakai
ambang p mentah < alpha, tanpa koreksi, persis pola raw-vs-FDR yang
sudah dipakai di S2-DAM-02. 

```{r persistence-raw}
persistence_raw <- monthly_lisa |>
  mutate(label_raw = ifelse(p_sim < ALPHA, quadrant, "Insignificant")) |>
  group_by(province) |>
  summarise(
    n_HH_raw = sum(label_raw == "High-High"),
    n_LL_raw = sum(label_raw == "Low-Low"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    persistence_category_raw = case_when(
      n_HH_raw >= PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS ~ "Persistent Hotspot",
      n_LL_raw >= PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS ~ "Persistent Coldspot",
      n_HH_raw > 0 & n_LL_raw > 0              ~ "Mixed/Unstable",
      n_HH_raw > 0                             ~ "Sporadic Hotspot",
      n_LL_raw > 0                             ~ "Sporadic Coldspot",
      TRUE                                     ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) |>
  right_join(tibble(province = province_order), by = "province") |>
  arrange(match(province, province_order))

persistence_raw$persistence_category_raw <- factor(persistence_raw$persistence_category_raw, levels = PERSISTENCE_LEVELS)

knitr::kable(
  persistence_raw |> count(persistence_category_raw, .drop = FALSE),
  caption = "Jumlah provinsi per kategori -- versi p mentah (eksploratif, TIDAK dikoreksi FDR)"
)
```

# 10. Peta hotspot/coldspot persisten

Semua 38 provinsi ditampilkan, termasuk "Not significant" (abu-abu) --
tidak di-drop dari peta maupun legenda, sesuai acceptance criteria.

```{r map-persistence, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
persistence_colors <- c(
  "Persistent Hotspot"  = "#d7191c",
  "Persistent Coldspot" = "#2c7bb6",
  "Sporadic Hotspot"    = "#fdae61",
  "Sporadic Coldspot"   = "#abd9e9",
  "Mixed/Unstable"      = "#984ea3",
  "Not significant"     = "#e0e0e0"
)

map_data <- boundary_sf |>
  left_join(persistence, by = "province")

ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = persistence_category), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = persistence_colors, name = "Kategori", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Hotspot/coldspot persisten (FDR-corrected), 2024-01 s.d. 2025-12",
    subtitle = paste0("Ambang persistence: signifikan (FDR<0.05) di >= ", PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS, "/24 bulan")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

Peta pembanding (eksploratif, **belum** dikoreksi FDR) kalau peta di
atas didominasi abu-abu, peta ini menunjukkan pola mentah yang masih ada
sebelum koreksi multiple testing diterapkan. **Jangan jadikan peta ini
sebagai klaim final, fungsinya cuma menunjukkan "ada apa di baliknya"
sebelum dikoreksi, bukan pengganti hasil yang rigorous di atas.

```{r map-persistence-raw, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
map_data_raw <- boundary_sf |> left_join(persistence_raw, by = "province")

ggplot(map_data_raw) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = persistence_category_raw), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = persistence_colors, name = "Kategori", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Hotspot/coldspot persisten (p mentah, TIDAK dikoreksi FDR) -- eksploratif",
    subtitle = paste0("Ambang persistence: signifikan (p<", ALPHA, ", mentah) di >= ", PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS, "/24 bulan")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

# 11. Stabilitas klasifikasi antarbulan

Selain kategori akhir, ditampilkan juga seberapa sering label tiap
provinsi **berubah** dari satu bulan ke bulan berikutnya -- ukuran
stabilitas langsung, terpisah dari kategori persistence itu sendiri.

```{r stability-transitions}
transitions <- monthly_lisa |>
  arrange(province, match(period, periods)) |>
  group_by(province) |>
  mutate(label_change = label_fdr != lag(label_fdr)) |>
  summarise(
    n_transitions = sum(label_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_distinct_labels = n_distinct(label_fdr),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  right_join(tibble(province = province_order), by = "province") |>
  arrange(match(province, province_order))

knitr::kable(
  transitions,
  caption = "Jumlah pergantian label FDR antarbulan per provinsi (0 = label sama sepanjang 24 bulan)"
)
```

# 13. Validation manifest

```{r validation}
checks <- list(
  n_provinces_is_38 = length(province_order) == 38,
  n_months_is_24 = length(periods) == 24,
  no_na_in_monthly_variable = !any(is.na(panel$treatment_started_per_100k_population)),
  no_island_in_primary = n_island_primary == 0,
  primary_has_1_connected_component = n_components_primary == 1,
  all_provinces_have_persistence_category = !any(is.na(persistence$persistence_category)),
  all_6_categories_in_legend = length(levels(persistence$persistence_category)) == 6
)

failed_checks <- names(checks)[!unlist(checks)]
overall_status <- if (length(failed_checks) == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL"

cat("Status keseluruhan:", overall_status, "\n")
if (length(failed_checks) > 0) cat("Gagal:", paste(failed_checks, collapse = ", "), "\n")

validation <- list(
  generated_at = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
  variable = "treatment_started_per_100k_population, per bulan (24 cross-section)",
  weights_primary = "spatial_weights_v2_queen_bridge.csv (dari S2-DAM-01)",
  persistence_definition = list(
    threshold_months = PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD_MONTHS,
    total_months = length(periods),
    significance_basis = "p_fdr < alpha (BUKAN p mentah)",
    categories = PERSISTENCE_LEVELS,
    pre_specified_before_running = TRUE
  ),
  reproducibility = list(seed = SEED, n_permutations = N_PERMUTATIONS, alpha = ALPHA),
  category_counts = as.list(table(persistence$persistence_category)),
  validation_checks = checks,
  failed_checks = failed_checks,
  status = overall_status
)

write_json(validation, file.path(CURATED, "hotspot_persistence_validation_R.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
cat("Tersimpan: hotspot_persistence_validation_R.json\n")
```

# 14. Interpretasi dan keterbatasan

- Kategori "Not significant" **sengaja ditampilkan**, bukan dihilangkan --
  kalau jumlahnya besar, itu temuan yang jujur (konsisten dengan hasil
  S2-DAM-02 yang juga menunjukkan sedikit signifikansi setelah FDR),
  bukan kegagalan analisis.
- Ambang 12/24 bulan bersifat pre-specified sesuai bagian 2. Kalau tim
  ingin mencoba ambang lain (mis. 8/24), itu keputusan metodologis baru
  yang harus didokumentasikan terpisah, bukan menggantikan definisi ini
  secara diam-diam.
- Hanya 24 bulan data tersedia -- "persisten" di sini artinya persisten
  *dalam rentang data yang ada*, bukan klaim jangka panjang.
- Seperti LISA di S2-DAM-02, daya statistik terbatas untuk 38 unit; lihat
  `docs/lisa-memo.md` untuk diskusi lebih lengkap soal ini.
